sourceContract: Masters are preserved under masters/; each contains a real left default and right alternate view.

processing.paletteNearest: weighted RGB distance (2,3,1), quantized to each item palette subset from item-palettes.json; global 24-color validation remains enforced
processing.sampling: hard nearest pixel grid with opaque-neighborhood fallback; no smooth resize
processing.anchor: centered x pivot; items with inkMax use native height minus sixteen pixels, other ids minus four; every frame keeps the grounded bottom quarter alpha rooted
processing.animation: four idle frames per angle; only a small connected glow component may recolor; blink/sway/bubbles fall back to truthful identical poses without an explicit mask

default.fallback: No explicit motion mask is present; four exported poses remain identical.
